title: Auth – Supabase Email & Google OAuth
body:
**Description**
Implement Supabase auth flow, user registration, and the `handle_new_user` trigger that creates `users` and `profiles` rows. Add login UI in `app/(auth)/login` and registration UI in `app/(auth)/register`.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Users can sign‑up with email/password and Google.
- After successful signup the DB contains matching `users` and `profiles` rows.
- JWT is returned and stored in client state.
- Errors surface cleanly (invalid creds, duplicate email).

**Test Instructions**
- E2E test: sign‑up → verify DB rows via Supabase client mock.
- Unit test: auth hook `useAuth` returns user object after login.
- Lint + type‑check passes.

title: Job Type CRUD API & UI
body:
**Description**
Build REST endpoints (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/jobs`) and UI under `app/jobs` for creating, editing, and deleting job templates. Include preset selection (Uber, Bolt, Contract, Freelance, Custom) and custom field definition UI.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- All CRUD endpoints respect Supabase JWT and return 401 when missing.
- UI reflects saved job types instantly.
- Validation prevents duplicate names per user.
- Preset fields are pre‑populated, custom fields editable.

**Test Instructions**
- Integration tests: call each endpoint with valid/invalid JWT, verify status codes and DB changes.
- UI snapshot tests for job list and form.
- End‑to‑end flow: create job → verify in UI and DB.

title: Session Start / Stop API & UI
body:
**Description**
Implement `/api/sessions/start` (creates session with `started_at`) and `/api/sessions/:id/stop` (sets `ended_at` and `data`). UI: Start Session button (disabled if active) and Stop Session flow that prompts for end‑of‑session fields.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Only one active session per user; start button disabled when one exists.
- `started_at` stored correctly; `ended_at` null until stopped.
- All required fields saved in `data` JSONB.

**Test Instructions**
- Unit test for `useSession` hook: start → state updates, stop → state resets.
- API integration: POST start, then POST stop, verify DB rows.
- E2E: UI start → timer runs → stop → DB entry matches.

title: Live Session Timer (Zustand)
body:
**Description**
Global timer that reconstructs elapsed time from `started_at` on page load, updates every second, and survives browser/tab close.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Timer shows correct HH:MM:SS after reload.
- Accuracy within 1 s of real time.
- Stops when session is stopped.

**Test Instructions**
- Jest test for timer calculation logic (given a `started_at`, returns elapsed).
- Cypress test: start session, refresh page, verify timer continues.

title: Session History & Dashboard
body:
**Description**
Create `/api/sessions` list endpoint with filters (job, date) and UI page `app/sessions` that displays session cards, totals per job, and edit links.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- List endpoint returns only sessions for the authenticated user.
- UI shows correct totals and pagination.
- Edit link navigates to edit page with pre‑filled data.

**Test Instructions**
- API test: filter by job → correct subset.
- UI snapshot test for dashboard layout.
- End‑to‑end: create multiple sessions, verify totals.

title: Edit Audit Log
body:
**Description**
Add `PUT /api/sessions/:id` that updates session data **only** when a non‑empty `audit_note` is provided. Insert a row into `session_edit_audit_log` with old/new values, field name, timestamp, and note.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Update rejects missing `audit_note` (400).
- Log row created with correct fields.
- UI forces note entry before allowing save.

**Test Instructions**
- Unit test for audit middleware: missing note → error.
- DB test: after edit, log row exists with matching old/new values.
- E2E: edit session → verify note shown in UI and log entry via API mock.

title: Forgotten‑Session Reminder
body:
**Description**
Set up Supabase `pg_cron` job (hourly) that queries sessions where `ended_at IS NULL` and `started_at` exceeds `reminder_threshold_hours`. It calls `/api/sessions/remind` which sends an email via Resend and updates `reminder_sent_at`.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Cron runs hourly, triggers email after 8 h, then follow‑up after 16 h.
- `reminder_sent_at` prevents duplicate sends.
- Email content includes job name and start time.

**Test Instructions**
- Integration test for `/api/sessions/remind`: mock Resend, verify email payload.
- Unit test for cron query logic (use a test DB fixture).

title: Per‑Job Configuration (Phase 2)
body:
**Description**
Extend job schema with optional `hourly_rate`, `tax_percentage`, `km_deduction_rate`, `custom_deductions`. UI under job edit page to set these values.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Fields saved in job `data` JSONB.
- Validation (numeric, positive) enforced.
- Defaults applied when not set.

**Test Instructions**
- Unit tests for validation functions.
- API test: update job with config → DB reflects values.
- UI test: edit page persists changes.

title: IRD‑Compliant Reporting (Phase 3)
body:
**Description**
Compute business kilometres (`end_odometer - start_odometer`) per session, aggregate per month, and expose a CSV export endpoint (`GET /api/reports/ird`). UI: “Download IRD Report” button.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Report includes required columns (date, job, km, earnings, GST).
- CSV format matches specification in `docs/api.md`.

**Test Instructions**
- End‑to‑end: generate report for known data set, compare CSV output to fixture.
- Unit test for aggregation logic.

title: Mobile‑Ready API Documentation
body:
**Description**
Generate OpenAPI spec covering all endpoints, ensure JWT validation, CORS config, and versioning. Add integration tests that simulate a mobile client (no UI).

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Spec is up‑to‑date, passes Swagger validation.
- Mobile client test suite passes all CRUD operations.

**Test Instructions**
- Run `npm run lint:api` (or equivalent) to validate spec.
- CI step executes mobile integration tests.

title: CI / Lint / Test Pipeline
body:
**Description**
Configure GitHub Actions to run ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript `tsc`, and Jest on every PR. Enforce Conventional Commits via commit‑lint.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- CI fails on lint or type errors.
- All tests must pass before merge.

**Test Instructions**
- Action scripts already defined in repo; verify they trigger on PR.
- Manual run of `npm test` passes locally.

title: Documentation & Handoff
body:
**Description**
Update `README.md` with quick‑start, link to `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/api.md`, `docs/auth.md`. Add Confluence page (or GitHub Wiki) summarizing tickets, linking each to its issue.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- All docs build without broken links.
- Ticket numbers appear in the documentation index.

**Test Instructions**
- Run `npm run docs:check` (if exists) to ensure links resolve.
- Manual review of generated wiki page.
